reply_text: @Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in your opening message in this channel. Per the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. At 11:03 AM Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did in between, so for more detail the postmortem would need to ask the guard or check the dispatch records.
